limitation: Capability does not establish distributed causal estimation
inspection: Primary README/license/package or repository metadata; selected API source where saved. No runtime package benchmark.
pin_limit: Content hashes pin actual saved artifacts. Retrieved HEAD, if present, is a separate observation; mutable-branch files are not asserted to belong to that commit.

scientific_qualification.input: Versioned frames/files and a lazy/eager expression plan with selected engine.
scientific_qualification.assumptions: Reordering, null handling, casts and time-zone/ordering semantics preserve the intended history and numerical result.
scientific_qualification.adapter_rule: Retain the engine and physical plan; larger-than-memory and GPU declarations are capabilities to qualify, not causal-estimation speed evidence. Distributed cloud is not assumed to be the OSS execution path.
scientific_qualification.acceptance_test: Require batch/streaming equivalence for ordered histories and cluster score sums within a declared tolerance; profile peak memory and unsupported-operation fallback.

evidence.finding: Lazy/eager engine, streaming, GPU and Arrow-interoperability declarations.
